build.//env: FURLPAY_ENV is read by app.config.js, which resolves the API base, the applicationId/bundleIdentifier suffix and the display name from it. Nothing else in the app hardcodes a backend. Profiles that omit it fall back to a profile-name heuristic in the same file, but SETTING IT EXPLICITLY is the contract — a renamed profile must not silently repoint a build at production.
build.//preview: Renamed in spirit, not in key: `preview` is the STAGING lane. The key stays because `eas build --profile preview` is in muscle memory and in the READMEs; the env var is what decides the backend.

preview.//ios: Ad-hoc distribution needs registered device UDIDs. Until an Apple Developer account exists, build the simulator target instead — it needs no signing and still proves the native project compiles.

build.//staging: Explicit alias for `preview`, so CI and humans can name the environment rather than a legacy profile name. Same output.

production.//ios: Apple requires apps be built with the iOS 18 SDK (Xcode 16+) since 2025-04-24; EAS defaults to Xcode 16 for SDK 52+, so no image pin is needed. A store build needs a paid Apple Developer account, a distribution certificate and a provisioning profile — none of which exist yet.

submit.//: There is no staging/dev submit lane on purpose. Non-production builds carry a suffixed applicationId (com.furlpay.app.staging), which has no Play listing and no App Store record — `eas submit` on one would either fail or, worse, need a second listing to be created that testers could mistake for the real app. Non-prod builds are distributed as APK / internal-distribution links.

android.//: The CANONICAL Play artifact is this React Native app. The TWA in apps/android shares the package name com.furlpay.app and must never be submitted — see apps/android/DEPRECATED.md.

ios.//: BLOCKED ON AN APPLE DEVELOPER ACCOUNT. ascAppId, appleTeamId and either an App Store Connect API key or an Apple ID must be supplied before `eas submit -p ios` can run. They are deliberately absent rather than filled with placeholders: a wrong ascAppId submits this binary to somebody else's app record.
ios.//credentials: eas credentials -p ios   — then set ascAppId and appleTeamId here.
